title: Villarroel approached by people she suspects have intelligence backgrounds
summary: Beatriz Villarroel tells of Villarroel approached by people she suspects have intelligence backgrounds, about 2025 at Stockholm, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have been approached by some people I suspect have it.

plain: An astronomer in Stockholm named Beatriz Villarroel, who studies old sky photographs for strange objects, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2025 she was approached by people she suspects have backgrounds in intelligence, meaning spy agencies. She did not say who they were. Her account hints that her research has drawn quiet interest from government circles.
